linkedin.copy:
Why the next generation of on-chain credit cannot rely on EVM-style shared liquidity pools.

During high-volatility market events, decentralized lending markets face two structural failure modes:

1. Mempool congestion spikes transaction fees, delaying borrower defensive rebalances.
2. Shared pool storage forces haircuts across all depositors when an exotic collateral asset depegs.

Vanna addresses both challenges directly at the smart contract execution layer on Stellar Soroban:

• Dedicated SmartAccount sandboxes isolate each borrower's risk. Deficits remain quarantined without compromising core pool reserves.
• Sub-second event streaming via the Mercury indexer enables automated rebalances in ~320ms.
• Predictable transaction fees fixed at 0.00014 XLM eliminate bidding wars against liquidation bots.

The architecture is live on testnet: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

reddit.copy:
**Title:** A technical breakdown of how we solved liquidation front-running and pool contagion on Soroban.

Most discussions around DeFi leverage focus on APY, but the real technical bottleneck has always been liquidation execution.

If you have ever had a position liquidated on Ethereum or an L2, you know the mechanic: market drops, gas spikes, and MEV searchers front-run your rebalance. You take a 10% penalty fee simply because your transaction was priced out of the block.

Here is how we designed Vanna's credit layer on Stellar Soroban to eliminate that failure mode:

- **State Isolation:** Borrowers execute within dedicated SmartAccount contract instances rather than sharing a global storage state. If one position enters deficit, it is strictly isolated.
- **Off-Chain Stream Monitoring:** We use the Mercury indexer to stream ledger events in under 320ms.
- **Non-Custodial Keeper Defense:** When a position reaches 1.25x Net Health Factor, our Risk Guardian triggers a defensive rebalance inside the user's sandbox at a fixed cost of 0.00014 XLM. There is no mempool to bid against.

Documentation and testnet sandbox deployments are live: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

*(Disclosure: Core builder at Vanna Protocol. Testing on Stellar Testnet only.)*
